reply.text:
Knee pain is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I won't assess it or tell you whether it's something to worry about. Please get it looked at, and let them tell you what's safe for your running and your knees.

On the training side, I can move your cardio toward swimming while you sort that out. That's a program change, so I'll propose it now and the app will show you the change to confirm before it applies. Check the change on screen and tap to confirm if it looks right. When you're back from the doctor or physio, tell me what they say and we'll plan the rest around it.
